financialNormalization.input: DefiLlama summary dailyFees and dailyRevenue per mapped providerSlug
financialNormalization.history: 30 exact dates; null for missing values
financialNormalization.summaryTotals: Saved only for comparison; do not substitute when daily grid incomplete.

narrativeNormalization.identityCheck: Contract must match meta.base.address or meta.quote.address and discovery metadata. Never infer from row rank or price.
narrativeNormalization.grid: 24 or 168 UTC bucket starts ascending; [T-W,T), T=2026-09-26T16:00:00Z
narrativeNormalization.sum: Each chain:pool once; missing pool interval makes aggregate null.
narrativeNormalization.boundary: Observed inclusive aligned before_timestamp; request T-1 and still post-filter. Minute sum verified CALI hour starts.
narrativeNormalization.pagination: Initial token pools: one page only. Histories: one 168-bucket request each, plus CALI two-bucket prefix repair after inclusive-boundary discovery.
narrativeNormalization.population: Two selected tokens per narrative. Pool universe not exhausted; CEX excluded; current membership reconstructed retrospectively.

creationRecipe.instructions: Use documented factory address and event ABI; anchor blocks by timestamps; scan all logs with pagination to finalized end block. Deduplicate chain+transaction+log index. V2 requires its own event definitions. Do not count discovered pairs.
